data.title: Tiler
data.summary: The role covers full wet-room renovations, from protection and demolition to waterproofing, tiling and finishing. Work sites vary, and the employment is permanent.

requirements.text: Experience in tiling and waterproofing work
Ability to work independently and systematically
requirements.question: What does 'independent and systematic work' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for independent and systematic work without describing what it involves.

requirements.text: Careful workmanship and good problem-solving skills
requirements.question: What does 'careful workmanship and good problem-solving skills' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting seeks careful workmanship and problem-solving without giving a practical example.

requirements.why: The posting requests a customer-service-oriented attitude without describing expected situations.

requirements.text: Access to a car for travel between work sites

requirements.question: What does 'professional skill' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting requires work experience and professional skill without defining the expected level.

requirements.text: Good spoken and comprehension skills in Finnish
requirements.question: Is Finnish needed from day one, or could someone start in English and build up Finnish on the job?
requirements.why: The posting requires strong spoken and comprehension skills in Finnish for the role.
